test_title: SSC CGL 2024 Tier-I Official Paper (Held On: 25 Sept, 2024 Shift 3)
subject: general
question: Which of the following schemes of the Government of India is a part of the 'Target Group' approach?

options.text: Command Area Development & Water Management Programme (CADP)

solution:
The correct answer is __**Marginal Farmers Development Agency (MFDA)**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] __Key Points__

__

• The Marginal Farmers Development Agency (MFDA) was initiated by the Government of India to address the specific needs of marginal farmers.

• It aims to improve the socio-economic conditions of marginal farmers by providing them with necessary resources, training, and support.

• MFDA focuses on increasing agricultural productivity and income through various development programs and strategies tailored for the target group.

• The scheme includes components such as credit facilities, supply of inputs, irrigation, training, and market linkages to ensure comprehensive support for marginal farmers.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

• **Drought Prone Areas Programme (DPAP)**

• DPAP is one of the earliest area development programs initiated by the Government of India to tackle the problems of drought in vulnerable areas.

• The primary objective is to minimize the adverse effects of drought on crop production, livestock, and productivity of land, water, and human resources.

• **Hill Areas Development Programme (HADP)**

• HADP was launched to ensure the socio-economic development of hill areas and their people.

• The program aims at addressing the unique problems faced by hill areas, including environmental degradation and lack of basic infrastructure.

• **Command Area Development & Water Management Programme (CADP)**

• CADP was initiated to enhance the utilization of irrigation potential created under major and medium irrigation projects.

• The program focuses on improving water use efficiency and ensuring equitable distribution of water.
